_note: Minimum-order and pickup/delivery-charge rules (founder-approved spec §2.3). Config is the single source of truth — thresholds/fees are NEVER hardcoded across components. Rule: an order whose eligible total is at or above `free_delivery_min` gets FREE pickup & delivery; below it a single flat `delivery_fee` applies (stated up front). Amounts are per-currency and already final/VAT-inclusive (services.money). Keyed by market so AED (UAE) and QAR (Qatar) can diverge later without code changes. Comparison for free delivery is >= (an order exactly at the minimum ships free).
